confidence_notes: I based the restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors on web searches of crowdsourced cost-of-living data. MyLifeElsewhere lists Victoria at about USD 15 for an inexpensive meal, USD 4.60 for a cappuccino and USD 3.90 for a local beer, with wide ranges. Bearsavings gives national Seychelles averages of USD 17.58 for a basic meal, USD 4.90 for a cappuccino and USD 3.41 for a 500ml beer. Restaurant beer is set above the crowdsourced average because these averages likely include shop or local-bar prices. The search did not return a figure for the mid-range meal for two, so it is estimated at roughly 5 times the inexpensive meal, in line with typical island tourist pricing. Cocktail and wine prices are also estimates, based on the usual local price relationship to beer in Seychelles, where imported spirits and wine are expensive. They are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Seychelles has very few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain. The FX rate is the RBA's 18 November 2026 4pm figure as reported in search-result summaries. I did not open or check the rba.gov.au page myself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are similar to Port Louis, Mauritius and Malé, Maldives: small, import-dependent Indian Ocean island capitals with high tourism demand and accommodation costs above the African average.
